Per root directive 21:37Z, phase-2b E2E authoring started SPECULATIVELY in isolated worktrees: Run wf_ae9131ef-398. Runs on current pins are not final acceptance; final runs re-pin to the final synckit/reposync merges.
- (1) synckit exported in-process delivery harness: branch cc-sync/synckit-harness from ea6d2df, worktree /Users/yasyf/.claude/worktrees/synckit/harness. daemon.NewHarness runs the REAL deliveryScheduler/deliverOnce/delivery store between N in-process hosts with fault-injectable Links, plus Kick/Status/WaitIdle; the synckitd production path is unchanged. This avoids a test-only mover, so the E2E exercises the real deliverer. It merges into the synckit final after that lands.
- (2) cc-sync SimHost harness: branch cc-sync/e2e from integration 736f3c1, worktree /Users/yasyf/.claude/worktrees/cc-sync/e2e, build tag e2e. Each simulated host gets fully isolated dirs, the real resident pipeline (artifact.Store, catalog, reposync store, capture, scheduler on a fake clock, and a consumer over a real rpc dispatcher on a unix socket), synthetic Claude layouts and sessions, a shared bare origin with per-host clones, a fake orca CLI, and a fake netpolicy monitor.
- (3) Four parallel scenario groups (branches cc-sync/e2e-{code-fidelity,delivery-integrity,policy-expiry,scale-scheduling}) cover every approved acceptance item plus D7/D13/D15. They then merge into an acceptance matrix that labels each item PASS / FAIL-dep / FAIL-product / NOT-COVERED.
- Scheduler Stop fix complete: cc-sync/scheduler-stopfix @ 753bd85. Stop now cancels the work context directly. Astra also found that a Stop-before-Run left pending Kicks hung; the refix closes `exited` under the life lock. -race -count=100 on the Stop/Kick tests passes. It merges in phase 2b.
